agents.title: Connected Agents
anomaly.endpoint.tip: Endpoints the AutoEncoder flagged as abnormal based on request characteristics (URI length, parameters, auth, User-Agent, and so on). A higher anomaly rate warrants attention.
anomaly.ip.tip: IPs whose request sequence (chronological behaviour) the LSTM judged abnormal. Suspect automated scanning, bots, or unusual access.
anomaly.noauth.tip: Endpoints called without an Authorization header. May be public APIs, or paths where authentication was not applied.
anomaly.noauth.title: Endpoints without authentication
anomaly.offhour.tip: Requests outside an endpoint's usual active window (core hours — any hour holding 10%+ of its traffic). Off-hour access can indicate bots or insider activity.
anomaly.slow.tip: Endpoints with the highest p95 response time (only those with 10+ calls, to exclude small-sample noise). Candidates for performance bottlenecks.
app.title: NGINX API Discovery Dashboard
chart.status.tip: Response status distribution (2xx success, 3xx redirect). 4xx/5xx are dropped during collection.
chart.top10.tip: The 10 most-called endpoints. Shows where traffic concentrates.
flow.filterHint: Use Flow filters to highlight matching API nodes.
flow.tip: Discovered APIs as a domain → path-segment hierarchy. Click a node to expand or collapse, drag to move, scroll to zoom.
flow.title: API Flow
footer.license: Free to use · Redistribution, modification and resale prohibited
inventory.selectAll: Select all shadow rows on this page
inventory.tip: Every discovered API endpoint. In the Status column, 'Managed' means the endpoint is defined in your OpenAPI spec; 'Shadow' means it is not.
inventory.title: API Inventory
js.addToSpec: Add this endpoint to the OpenAPI spec
js.agentEmpty3: It must use the same INGEST_TOKEN as this dashboard.
js.allSpecUsed: None — every spec endpoint receives traffic
js.bulkHint: Adds every checked shadow endpoint to the spec at once.
js.bulkNeedSpec: Upload an OpenAPI spec from the {tab} tab first.
js.noApiData: No API data yet. Run the pipeline.
js.noDomain: No domain available for this request. Check the endpoint's inventory domain.
js.pwTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
js.serverError: Server error (HTTP {status}) — check the server log.
login.subtitle: Sign in to the dashboard
login.title: Sign in · NGINX API Discovery
model.ae.tip: Compresses and reconstructs each request's 26-dimensional feature vector. A large reconstruction error means the request is far from the learned normal distribution.
model.loss.tip: Training and validation loss per epoch. Both falling together is healthy; diverging suggests overfitting.
model.lstm.tip: Learns each IP's request sequence (last 10 requests) to detect behavioural anomalies. Effective against access with abnormal ordering or timing.
shadow.tip: Unmanaged APIs — endpoints absent from the OpenAPI spec, or flagged by ML as rare patterns. Suspect undocumented or hidden APIs.
spec.addHint: Shadow APIs can be added individually from the Endpoints tab.
spec.dropzone: Drag a YAML / JSON file here, or
spec.empty: Appears once an OpenAPI spec is uploaded
spec.key.title: Title
spec.required: A spec must be uploaded before endpoints can be added.
spec.tip: Upload an OpenAPI 2.0/3.0 spec and it is compared against real traffic to find endpoints missing from the spec (Shadow) and endpoints only in the spec (Unused).
stat.calls.tip: Total calls counted from 2xx/3xx responses only, across the 7 days retained in the database.
stat.endpoints.tip: Number of unique (method, normalized URI) pairs called at least 10 times. Static assets and 4xx/5xx-only requests are excluded.
stat.ips.tip: Number of unique client IPs that sent requests.
stat.model.tip: AutoEncoder + LSTM training status. 'Trained' means the anomaly-detection models are ready to use.
stat.noauth.tip: Endpoints called without an Authorization header. Candidates for APIs that need no authentication, or are missing it.
stat.shadow.tip: Number of unmanaged APIs — endpoints absent from the OpenAPI spec, or flagged by ML as rare patterns.
unused.tip: Endpoints defined in the OpenAPI spec that receive no traffic. Candidates for unused or deprecated APIs.
